flashcards.q: How is inbound leads used in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: This chapter teaches you how to design, launch and supervise AI agents that carry out sales work with some degree of independence: researching accounts, qualifying inbound leads, drafting outreach, updating the CRM and booking meetings.

flashcards.q: How should everything gathered not be handled in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Doubling the steps multiplied the cost by 2.72, not 2, because every extra step re-reads everything gathered before it.

flashcards.q: What does AI Sales Agents Deployment teach about agent?
flashcards.a: The word "agent" is used loosely in the software market, so it is worth fixing a precise meaning before going further.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with advance in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: The defining feature is that the sequence of steps is not fixed in advance.

flashcards.q: When is volume verifiability applied in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Select a first agent task by scoring candidates on volume, verifiability and the cost of an error.

flashcards.q: When should gets not be used in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: It does not feel embarrassment when it gets a name wrong, so it will not become more careful on its own.

flashcards.q: Where does king Academy come up in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: The chapter closes with a field case from the Sales King Academy platform, where a change in model routing by customer tier corrected the economics of its own agents, and a lab in which you build and test an agent of your own on the live site.

flashcards.q: Where does opt-out not apply in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: - **Email.** In the United States, the CAN-SPAM Act sets rules for commercial email: no false or misleading header information or subject lines, identification of the message as an advertisement where required, a valid physical postal address, a clear way to opt out, and honouring opt-out requests within ten business days.

flashcards.q: Is decide whether always required in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: For each error found, decide whether it calls for a change to instructions, knowledge, tools or guardrails, and record the change with the date.

flashcards.q: Is outreach agent ever unnecessary in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: A **serious error** for an outreach agent might be a false fact about the prospect, a message to someone who should not have been contacted, or any mention of price or terms.

flashcards.q: Which approach to usually fits AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Each can have instructions and knowledge focused on one job, which usually improves quality.

flashcards.q: Which uses of autonomy should be ruled out in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: It helps to describe autonomy as a scale rather than a yes-or-no choice.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with staged rollout in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: You will learn to write an agent's job description, estimate its cost per task and per conversation, model its effect on pipeline, run a staged rollout with clear promotion rules, and meet the legal and ethical duties that come with letting software speak to buyers.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling speaks in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: It is rarely appropriate for anything that speaks to a buyer on the company's behalf, because a message once sent cannot be unsent.

flashcards.q: Why does reason matter in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Write a CRM record with the lead, the fit assessment and the reason, and end the run.

flashcards.q: Why is paying customers not always the right choice in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: **No reason to upgrade.** If free users already received the largest model, paying customers did not get a clearly better experience in exchange for their Beats.

flashcards.q: How is kill switch used in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Apply least-privilege permissions and guardrails such as step caps, spending caps, recipient allowlists, quiet hours and a kill switch.

flashcards.q: How should many runs not be handled in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: First, set a step cap and track how many runs hit it, because runs at the cap are expensive and often failures in disguise, such as an agent searching repeatedly for something it cannot find.

flashcards.q: What does AI Sales Agents Deployment teach about looks?
flashcards.a: In this course, an **AI agent** is a system that is given a goal, decides for itself which steps to take toward it, uses tools to take those steps, looks at the results, and either continues, stops or asks a person for help.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with anything in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: It does not look anything up unless you paste it in, it does not send the email, and it does not decide what to do next.

flashcards.q: When is contact buyers applied in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Explain the main legal and ethical duties when agents contact buyers, including AI disclosure, consent for outreach and honest identity.

flashcards.q: When should idempotent action not be used in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: - **Make writes idempotent where you can.** An **idempotent** action has the same effect whether it runs once or several times: "set the stage to Qualified" is idempotent, while "add a new task" is not.

flashcards.q: Where does observation come up in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Observation: team size and industry fit; budget unknown.

flashcards.q: Where does qualification not apply in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Check that qualification rules use business criteria, such as company size, industry and stated need, and not proxies that could disadvantage people unfairly.

flashcards.q: Is deterministic recall always required in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: For each reply, note the source badge shown (deterministic recall, verified knowledge, web or AI), whether the reply stayed within scope, and whether any fact in it would need checking before use with a buyer.

flashcards.q: Which approach to tiers fits AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: The tiers were priced differently but served the same way, which weakens the case for upgrading.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with contact buyers in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Explain the main legal and ethical duties when agents contact buyers, including AI disclosure, consent for outreach and honest identity.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling judgment in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: It has no judgment about the relationship with a long-standing customer beyond what its instructions and memory supply.

flashcards.q: Why does escalation rule matter in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: The escalation rule matters as much as the goal.

flashcards.q: How is unit economics used in AI Sales Agents Deployment?
flashcards.a: Estimate the cost per task and per conversation of an agent, and show how model routing changes unit economics.
